segments.text: Miori is a very sweet and friendly girl. Before arriving in Sweet Wonderland she had attended an all-girls school, so she was shy about talking to Alice at first, but that does not stop her from forming a fast friendship with him.

Unlike the new players, Miori is in no hurry to collect the marks that allow her to return to her world, seemingly enjoying being in Sweet Wonderland. Despite her shining personality, she seems to have certain secrets locked inside her.
Edited from Iori's review
夢の国スウィートワンダーランドに招かれた、「アリス」と呼ばれる少女。
ありすと同じく現実の世界からやってきた。
性格はほがらかでほんわか、お菓子と絵本が大好きな女の子。
女の子が好きそうな事は、大抵好き。動物好き。占いもおまじないも好き。
普通の女の子と違う所は、子供の頃は田舎で暮らしていたので、虫や爬虫類が平気なことくらい。
夢の国の中では最も常識人で（そもそも住人ではないので）、ありすに強引に迫ったりせず、まともに話が出来る数少ない相手。
ただし、ややのんびりな性格上この世界にはすっかり順応しているようで、ありすと違ってここでの状況を割と楽しんでいる。
ありすと競う事になっても、特にライバル意識などはなく「お互い仲良く頑張りましょ！」程度にしか思っていない。

segments.text: Queen of Sweet Wonderland. She says that any resident of Sweet Wonderland that finishes her collection game will have their wish granted (in the case of Alice, he simply wants to return to his own world).

Lavinia is a girl of small build who despises being called "little" and will not hesitate to decapitate anyone who calls her such. Unlike the Queen of Hearts in Carroll's work, Lavinia is a fair and responsible ruler (but equally temperamental).
Despite knowing about everything happening in her kingdom, Lavinia is very innocent in regards to adult matters, so she is very eager to use Alice as a "guinea pig".
Rouge13 and Emudori are her direct subordinates.
Edited from Iori's review

The first resident of Sweet Wonderland that Alice meets. When he takes a shortcut to class through the campus golf course, Silk leads him through a hole to the Land of Dreams.

Silk is a cute and quiet rabbit girl, naive in terms of "things between boys and girls". She lives in a house south-east of the Lavinia's castle and has an incredible craving (perhaps "vice" would be the right word) for carrots, for which she will do unthinkable things.

Unlike her counterpart (the White Rabbit in Carroll's novel), Silk is never in a hurry... always taking things slowly, unless there is something that interests her, and then all her energy is released.

While Alice is trying to find his way through a lush forest, he hears a strange voice calling him. To his surprise, he see it is the floating head of a cat girl.

Neko-san (as she calls herself), loves to bother Alice. With a fun and energetic personality, Neko-san never takes things seriously (unless it includes an evening alone with Alice), and although she is not as bizarre as her counterpart in Carroll's novel, she always has a smile on her face.

With her power to disappear, Neko-san scares Alice whenever she can, and sometimes her jokes seem to have no limit. She never misses an opportunity to suggest that she and Alice should do "little things" together.

segments.text: The third member of the Tea Party. Luna is very nervous, exaggerated and imaginative. Although she's a little strange, she possesses an aura of maturity that makes Alice look at her as an "onee-san".

Luna helps Funny all she can with the preparation of the tea because she loves it so much (and also because she has to make her special milk tea). She loves her two friends and does not hesitate to make Alice feel at home every time he visits (even though she frequently has to be hit by Yamane-san to be brought out of her daydreams, whose themes are not suitable for children when she is around Alice).

Luna is the game adaptation of the "March Hare" from Carroll's original novel, and while she loves to wear very flashy outfits, she does not have the feverish madness that characterized the original (except, of course, in her imagination).
Edited from Iori's review

segments.text: Trying to find a way out of the world he just arrived in, Alice arrives at a curious place that smells of coffee and tea. He is received by the "Tea Party" group, among which is Funny.

Funny (the game's version of the "Hatter" from Carroll's novel) can not avoid being nervous and a little scared the first time she meets Alice. Even though he slowly reveals his kind and gentle side, she is still shy around him.

She has a great taste for and knows a lot about tea and its various classes, and is always investigating new combinations and ingredients to make it. Luna and Yamane are her close friends, and they love having nice moments with tea and biscuits.
Although she is shy around Alice, their mutual love of cooking brings them closer together.
Edited from Iori's review

Part of the Tea Party group. Yamane-san is a fairly faithful adaptation of the Dormouse character in the novel by Carroll: she is always sleeping, except for the occasional moments where she'll wake up and say a phrase while still half-asleep. However, there is one thing that can bring her out of her sleepy stupor: molasses, her favorite candy.
Yamane has a big heart and loves her friends dearly. She is dressed in traditional Japanese clothing, which seems very strange to Alice.
She is forced to give Luna a "chop" to the head every time her imagination gets the better of her.

しかし、起きたときは「するのは良いけど、されるのは嫌」という、どちらかと言えばＳよりの属性。
いつも持っているどんぐりの実は、どんぐり型の容器で中には糖蜜（甘～いシロップのようなもの…と本人は言っている）が入っている。スウィートワンダーランドにおいての砂糖の原料はその糖蜜らしく、その糖蜜を作っている彼女がいないとお菓子を作れない。自分の作品（？）である糖蜜に並々ならぬ愛情を注いでおり、糖蜜（シロップ）プレイが大好き。
においフェチ。においで色々とかぎわけることができる。姿が見えなくてもにおいで察知することが可能。 他にも色々察知可能。
ひどい酒乱らしく、お茶会の仲間は絶対に彼女に酒を飲ませようとしない。
Emudori is Lavinia's bird, her personal assistant and loyal subordinate.
Emudori is extremely pompous and over-educated, and always supports the queen. However, Emudori often makes wisecracks, getting beaten by Lavinia and Alice as a result.
Being a resident of Sweet Wonderland, Emudori also participates in the game.

The protagonist of the story. A young college boy traveling to school is involved in a rare encounter with a mysterious rabbit girl who carries him to "Sweet Wonderland", the Dreamland where the story takes place.

He is quite responsible and enterprising, although he has a volatile temper whenever things don't go well (or when the girls tease him). He is studying literature, but his real passion is cooking (although he hates to admit it). Because he is the second "Alice" in Wonderland besides Miori, and also the first man in the country, his appearance causes a great deal of surprise.
Alice wants to go back to his world by any means possible, so he is more than willing to play Queen Lavinia's game.
Edited from Iori's review.
The 13 twin sisters that serve Lavinia. They are direct subordinates to the Queen, doing whatever is asked of them (including attempting to decapitate Alice or "analyze him").
The 13 have completely different personalities, but all are equally faithful to their queen and curious about Alice. Though they are supposed to obey Emudori, they rarely do.
The leader of the sisters is Rouge1, and despite the differences the sisters have, they all follow and love her.
Edited from Iori's review
